brook: spinning up gossamer-2.0 embed on staging. ran quick onboard: fp16, int8_pc, int8_sym, int6_mixed. short-holdout (<=12 tokens) shows a weird R@1 dip for int6_mixed.

brook: short R@1: fp16=0.788, int8_pc=0.777, int8_sym=0.760, int6_mixed=0.623. full wiki R@1 differences are small (~<0.02).

naiya: int6_mixed? what bits for projection vs storage?

brook: int6_mixed = int6 activations, per-channel; projection layer kept fp16. tried symmetric vs asymmetric scale; symmetric was slightly worse.

ravi: short queries amplify scale quant noise. did you try norm-before-quant?

brook: norm-before-quant -> int6_mixed R@1 improved 0.623 -> 0.681 (quick check). int8_sym still worse than int8_pc.

naiya: please attach eval command + seed + tokenizer. Also upload UMAP and pairwise cos histograms.

brook: eval cmd: redwood-eval --model gossamer-2.0 --quant int6_mixed --holdout /data/holdouts/short12.json --k 1,5 --seed 7 --tokenizer bertv3 --batch 128

brook: quick cos stats: fp16 avg_pos=0.79 avg_neg=0.22 | int6_mixed avg_pos=0.63 avg_neg=0.20 -> margin reduced.

ravi: margin erosion tracks with R@1 drop. recommend: 1) default to per-channel int8 for catalog; 2) if int6 desired, keep final projection fp16 and add norm-before-quant; 3) add short-query anchor tests to onboard checklist.

ops-bot: Staging cluster scaled +1 node for eval sweep at 2026-03-25T09:12:01Z

brook: will run multilingual micro-holdouts and try OPQ+int6 storage as alternative. I'll post artifacts in ~1.5h. tagging #embed-failures. :mag:
